candidate: Hurricane Harvey / FEMA historical geospatial damage assessments

source_layer.title: FEMA Historical Geospatial Damage Assessment Database
source_layer.self_description: Geospatial damage assessments from past National Disaster events conducted either using high-resolution imagery or by means of geospatial modeling.

gate1_independent_reference.verdict: FAIL — modeled flood-depth assessments (ASMT_TYPE=MOD), not field/UAV inspections

dedupe.method: Union-find on projected polygons; IoU > 0.5 treated as the same building. Canonical geometry is the unary union (fallback: largest-area member). Canonical uid / tile / split / subtype come from the largest-area member (tie-break: split order train/test/hold, then tile name, uid).

fema_label_tally_mapping: Frozen FEMA mapping in the repo (origin/main eval protocol): No Damage/Unaffected -> no-damage; Affected and Minor -> minor; Major -> major; Destroyed -> destroyed; UNK/empty -> unknown. Native codes NOD/AFF/MIN/MAJ/DES/UNK are mapped accordingly. No new filters.

gate2_spatial_alignment.verdict: COUNTS_ONLY — Gate 2 geometry can be measured, but Gate 1 failed so these matches are not eligible as independent-reference overlap

gate3_note: Not evaluable as a third-event independent-reference set while Gate 1 fails (modeled / non-field source).
blockers: All 156,099 Harvey records in the FEMA Historical Geospatial Damage Assessment Database have ASMT_TYPE=MOD (modeled) and DMG_TYPE=FL (flood). The service description states assessments were conducted 'either using high-resolution imagery or by means of geospatial modeling.' IMG_DATE is null for every Harvey record. This is not a field or UAV independent reference, so it cannot satisfy Gate 1 as frozen in the eval protocol (conflict ground truth must come from a non-satellite field/UAV source). Label tallies and matcher counts below are reported for coverage completeness only.

The former gis.fema.gov FEMA_Damage_Assessments service returns HTTP 404. disasters.geoplatform.gov Harvey DamageAssessments folders returned HTTP 500 on 2026-11-17. Live FEMA IA services on gis.fema.gov are zip/county/USNG aggregates, not building-level grades.
